verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official Stripe CLI to "build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line" [docs-19], and a probe confirmed the official CLI docs page exists [probe-5]. The evidence is only a one-line description, though, with nothing on Billing-specific commands or AI-oriented use. Missing for 10: detail on CLI coverage of Billing resources (subscriptions, invoices, meters), evidence of agent- or automation-friendly CLI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
